senses.gloss: m. (preced. wds.) hot-tempered, impetuous, opp. עִנְוְתָן.
units: <cite ref="Pirkei Avot 2:5">Ab. II, 5</cite> <he>לא הק׳ מלמד</he> (Ar. <he>הקו׳</he>) an impatient man cannot be a teacher.
<cite ref="Shabbat 30b:12">Sabb. 30ᵇ</cite> bot., v. <cite ref="P00965"><he>עִנְוְתָן</he></cite>; <cite ref="Avot D'Rabbi Natan 15:2">Ab. d’R. N. ch. XV</cite>.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 113a">Snh. 113ᵃ</cite> sq. (in Chal. dict.) <he>אבא אליהו ק׳ הוה</he> father Elijah (the prophet) was hot-tempered (dealing with Ahab too severely); <he>א״ל ק׳ קרית לי … דקא קפיד מר</he> said he (Elijah) to him, thou didst call me hot-tempered! Said he, this very case before us proves it, for thou art resentful; a. e.
